verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitHub has a Marketplace for installing third-party apps and integrations, and it ships first-party security features such as secret scanning, push protection, Autofix and dependency updates. Nothing ties these together into installing third-party security scanners from a security tab, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: evidence of a security tab with an integration install flow, third-party security-scanning tools listed in the Marketplace, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
